cohort: 8130 infants who did not have exclusive breastfeeding at 6 months of age and 53266 infants who did.
finding: Low birth weight, head circumference < 32.5 cm, cesarean section, older maternal age, maternal employment, and no breastfeeding at night were associated with non-exclusive breastfeeding at 6 months.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was associated with non-exclusive breastfeeding at 6 months.
birth_weight: Recorded, with specific interest in low birth weight
